info.title: MACH VON design API
info.description: Design contract, not deployed. JWT issuer/audience, verified membership, entitlements and action scope checked server-side. Money strings, cursor pagination, immutable revisions, UTC. ETag/If-Match for state changes; idempotency scoped to tenant+subject+operation+key. Non-tenant platform operations use separate audience. Baseline 1.3: explicit SystemAdmin theme workflow. Generic resource contracts remain scaffolding and require action DTO/policy review before implementation.

ReportNarrative.description: The words of a report (DIS-06 notes). Every section is optional in the weekly report; a section is at most 4000 characters and the issues are those of the project, each named once (at most 50). The member is the whole narrative: what it leaves out is removed from the draft.

ReportAttachmentRef.description: A file attached to a report, as the upload door `uploadReportFile` answered it. Only a file that the scan found clean, of this tenant, with this hash, can be attached (422 FILE_NOT_CLEAN, 409 SCAN_PENDING, 422 HASH_MISMATCH).

DisReportSubmitResult.description: The report that was handed in: the status SUBMITTED and the version it moved to, the time the server took, whether it was late by the calendar of its period, the SHA-256 of what it held, what the period added in all (negative when the cumulative fell, never forced to zero; null when no cell has a period before) and the warnings of the review (they do not block).

DisImportFile.description: The workbook of weekly reports once it is in the object store and clean: its key and hash are what createReportImport takes.

DisReportImport.description: A batch of the bulk import of weekly reports (DIS 3 F1): VALIDATED when every row is in order (it can be applied), DRY_RUN when some are not (it cannot), APPLIED once it made the drafts. errors has every fault of every row, by line, with the column and a stable code; nothing is skipped without one.

DisRateGroup.description: The two rates of a unit or a project: the sums of its lines, never the mean of the rates of its parts.

numerator_disbursed_vnd.description: Treasury payments up to the cutoff (year plan) or what was reported (capital carried over); null when nobody has the figure.

DisWeeklyPlanRow.description: A project and a week: the commitment (a plan, never counted as disbursed), what the Treasury paid in the week from the frozen close snapshots and their difference.

submitted.description: Handed in, including the ones that came in late.

outstanding_vnd.description: What is still owed on the invoice: what it stands for, less what was paid on it and on the invoices it replaced; the amount a payment must be to settle it

items.description: The invoices of the tenant, the latest period first

suspension_proposed_at.description: Set once a subscription has been 30 days past due: a suspension is only proposed, and only a System Admin decides it (BR-SAS-04)

next_cursor.description: The cursor of the next (older) page, null on the last

receivable_vnd.description: What the tenant owes: the originals that are not replaced, the adjustments and replacements that were issued, less what was paid

amount_vnd.description: Integer VND as decimal string

memo.description: The note of the transfer, where the payer writes the code of the invoice

items.description: The payments of the platform that wait for a person, or of one status, the latest first

exports_version.description: The number of exports the tenant has asked for: the If-Match of the next request (409 VERSION_CONFLICT when somebody asked meanwhile)

missing_files.description: Objects that rows refer to and no store returned: the export holds the reference without the file

withheld_files.description: Objects that rows refer to and the antivirus has not passed (pending or infected): they are not in the export

unreadable_tables.description: Tables of the tenant that the export could not read, so they are not in it

legal_holds_active.description: The legal holds in force on the tenant: the purge that follows the archive skips what they hold

url.description: Relative to the API; the signature is the only credential, valid for a few minutes

sha256.description: The hash the bytes must have: the owner checks it after the download

reserved_until.description: Until when the hostname of a released domain is held (90 days after the release)

txt_record_name.description: Where the proof is published, for a custom domain that is not proved yet

write_frozen_until.description: While the cutover is frozen: the instant until which the writes of the tenant are refused (503 TENANT_WRITE_FROZEN); the migration is rolled back when the switch has not happened by then

observation_ends_at.description: When the 24 hours of observation after the switch end and the migration is Completed

ended_by.description: Who aborted; null when the system rolled the migration back by itself

end_reason.description: The words of the System Admin who aborted, or FREEZE_EXPIRED / FINAL_VERIFICATION_FAILED when the system rolled back

last_error_code.description: The class of the failure that stopped the worker at the last pass (never its message)

PlacementReconciliation.description: The copy compared with the original, table by table: the number of rows, the checksum of the content of every column of every row (a change to any column changes it) and the sum of every numeric(24,0) money column (decimal text). A table is in agreement only when all three are the same.

unreadable_tables.description: Tables of the tenant plane that the worker cannot read: they are not compared

PlacementChoice.description: A placement a tenant can be moved to (or is on): infrastructure references are not shown

available.description: Whether a promotion can be started towards it: an Active silo with room

membership_ids.description: The people a test message may be sent to (at most ten, Active members of the tenant)

device_hint.description: The start and the end of the public id of the device, never the whole of it

credential_configured.description: The credential is a reference into the vault; the screen says "configured" and never shows it

webhook_configured.description: Whether the reference of a webhook secret is set; never the reference itself

verify_requested_at.description: Set while a verification asked for is waiting for the provider

verification_error.description: The reason the last verification failed (CREDENTIAL_INVALID, PROVIDER_UNREACHABLE...)

chunk_bytes.description: Every chunk has this size but the last, which is what is left

expires_at.description: When the links of `chunks` stop working; ask again for the missing ones

url.description: Where to PUT the bytes of this chunk: signed for this chunk and the tenant, valid for a few minutes

received.description: The chunks the server holds: an interrupted upload does not send them again

reason.description: Why the file was refused (FILE_INFECTED)

url.description: Where to PUT the bytes of this chunk: signed for this chunk and the tenant, valid for a few minutes

chunks.description: Fresh links for the chunks still to send; empty once the file is no longer being uploaded

ended.description: Attempts of the period that ended: delivered, read, failed, suppressed or unknown

unknown.description: Shown apart, and counted in the denominator

delivered_rate.description: (delivered + read) / denominator in percent, two decimals; null when nothing was sent

spent_month_vnd.description: Estimated, as the prices written on the attempts added up

held_by_limit.description: Messages waiting because the cap or the budget was reached

units.description: The units named by the segment, so whoever approves sees which departments get the broadcast

recipient_count.description: From the last preview; null before one

opted_out.description: The person turned the channel off for campaigns (NOT-03)

no_consent.description: The consent the table of BR-NOT-07 asks for is missing, withdrawn or expired

inactive.description: The membership is not Active now

duplicate.description: The person is reached by more than one membership of the segment and is written to once

excluded.description: The people left out of the last preview, by reason; absent before a preview

notification_count.description: The notifications made when the campaign was approved

waiting_count.description: Of them, those not yet sent out

contact_id.description: The contact that holds the identity: a contact that was merged keeps its identities and the contact it was merged into shows them

masked.description: The masked copy; the value and its hash are never returned

merge_candidates.description: The live contacts that share a Verified identity with this one (the same hash on both): the only ones it can be merged with; empty when there is none, which is when the merge is not offered (BR-OMNI-05)

identity_id.description: The Verified identity of this contact that names the share: the one a merge sends

queue_unit_id.description: The unit whose queue the conversation is in; none is the queue of the whole tenant

window_expires_at.description: Until when the tenant may answer freely (WhatsApp, Zalo OA: 24 hours after the last message of the person); none for a channel without a window

converted.description: True for the issue a conversion made; an issue linked by hand is not the result of one

resource_links.description: The records the conversation points to; the issue it was turned into is among them

text.description: The text of the message; only the read of one message carries it (the list is read for the order and the state, the text is personal data)

channels.description: The channels the rule is for; none means every channel

keywords.description: Words one of which must be in the first message, any case and accents; none means no word is asked for

queue_unit_id.description: The unit whose queue the conversation goes to

units.description: The units a rule may name as a queue: given with the policy, so that whoever manages it needs no other permission to choose one

projects.description: Only the projects the agent is scoped to: the only ones a conversation can be turned into an issue of

contracts.description: The contracts of the contractor that the caller reads, with what they may do on each

overall_score.description: Weighted by the rule CTR.SCORECARD, two decimal places

average_overall_score.description: Average of the approved evaluations that stand, two decimal places; none when there is no approved evaluation

evaluation_count.description: Every evaluation the caller reads in the range; the list holds at most 500 of them

violation_count.description: Every violation the caller reads in the range; the list holds at most 500 of them

summary.description: Counted over everything the caller reads in the range, not over the rows of the lists

rule.description: The rule CTR.SCORECARD the scores are weighted by; its thresholds await the signature of the business owner (R-CTR-05)

items.description: The contractors that hold a contract the caller reads, by name; at most 500

submitted_ref.description: The receipt number the national system gave, written down by hand

adapter.description: The adapter to the national database today: a file is proposed and its API is missing (CXN-EXE-01)

rows.description: By unit and group of issues

opened.description: Became open in the week: raised or reopened

closing.description: Open when the week ended: opening + opened - resolved

overdue.description: Of those open at the end, the ones past their deadline

units.description: By unit, the groups added up

closing.description: Open when the week ended: opening + opened - resolved

overdue.description: Of those open at the end, the ones past their deadline

PayGeneratedSettlementForms.description: Kết quả sinh biểu mẫu quyết toán: kết quả lệnh của hồ sơ quyết toán kèm các biểu mẫu vừa sinh

decision_draft_id.description: Bản dự thảo của quyết định 10/QTDA trong DOC, khi biểu mẫu này vừa được sinh

page_index.description: From 0; the screen shows the page as page_index + 1

ocr_confidence.description: Decimal string from 0 to 1 with up to four digits

table_mismatch.description: A table of the page states a total that is not the sum of its lines

text.description: The text the engine recognised, read from the object store and checked against its digest; null when it cannot be read

corrected_text.description: The text the reviewer put in its place, for a corrected page

financial_ready.description: No page of the proposal waits for a person: the financial analysis may run

blocked_pages.description: The number of pages of the proposal that wait for a person

threshold.description: The confidence under which a page waits, as a decimal string

reused.description: The same input was run before: this is that run, and no model was asked

failure_code.description: Why a run that did not reach the experts ended: AI_ROUTE_EXHAUSTED, REJECTED_NO_CITATION, OUTPUT_INVALID, AI_ROUTE_NOT_ALLOWED...

data_classification.description: The highest class of the files of the run, from the files and never from the caller

route_class.description: The route of the last attempt; null when the request was refused before any

policy_version_id.description: The classification policy in force when the request was routed; null for the baseline

cost_vnd.description: Whole VND settled at the gateway

AnalysisRunView.description: A run as a screen reads it: never the hash of its input or the request it made at the gateway

calc_ref.description: The figure the pipeline computed in code

verified_present.description: The words quoted are on the page they name (BR-BID-07)

confidence_type.description: A signal, never the probability of being right (BR-BID-08)

evidence_count.description: The citations that were found on their page

missing_source.description: The finding claimed without a verified citation and was taken back to NEEDS_REVIEW

final_status.description: What a person decided, the latest decision about the finding; null until one did. The status above is what the model said and never changes

reviewed_at.description: When the latest decision was made

final_score.description: The score of the latest decision that gave one

review_count.description: The decisions made about the finding

version.description: One more than the decisions made: the version a review names in If-Match

reviews.description: The history of the review, oldest first

AnalysisFindingSummary.description: How a finding stands, without what it says or what it rests on: those come with listAnalysisFindings

AnalysisReviewView.description: One decision of an expert about a finding (BR-BID-09): the record of what a person did with what the model said, kept for good

BidFindingDecision.description: The form of the review that approves what stands for a finding or sets it aside, naming the citations the expert checked. The reason is judged by the command (422 REASON_REQUIRED).

decision.description: approve keeps the status that stands; reject leaves NEEDS_REVIEW, so that no conclusion stands

evidence_ids.description: Citations of the finding that the expert checked

BidFindingReviewed.description: The decision that was recorded: the finding stands for the status of the decision from now on

status.description: The status that stands for the finding

resource_version.description: The version of the finding after the decision

run_status.description: COMPLETED once every finding of the run has a decision

basis_finding.description: The criterion of the finding of the analysis the question rests on; null for a contractor (a guest never sees the findings of the evaluation)

status.description: EXPIRED is what a request nobody answered by its deadline is shown as; the stored status stays SENT until a person acts on it

sent_document_id.description: The letter that carries the question: a confidential document of DOC about the request

answered_as_guest.description: True when the contractor answered themselves as a guest; false when the staff who took their letter recorded it

asked_by.description: The member of the evaluation team who asked; null for a contractor (the evaluators stay anonymous to the bidders)

answer.description: The request waits for its answer, in time, and the caller holds the permission to record it; the server judges the command again

column.description: A money column (name ends in _vnd) of the table

expected.description: The total the backup recorded, in dong, as a decimal text

restored.description: The total the restored copy holds, in dong, as a decimal text

matched.description: Every table has the rows, the checksum and the money totals the backup recorded, and no row of another tenant

foreign_rows.description: Rows of another tenant found in the restored copy: it must be 0

mismatches.description: What differs, as rows:table, checksum:table, money:table.column, missing_table:table, unexpected_table:table, foreign_rows

rpo_seconds.description: How far before the recovery point asked for the restored copy stops

rto_seconds.description: From the approval to the end of the verification

sandbox_ref.description: Where the restored copy was placed (a sandbox restore only)

error_code.description: The class of the failure, never its message

verification_report_ref.description: sha256 of the verification report: the drill record
